RECIPES.name: Creamy Tomato Pasta
RECIPES.description: A cozy weeknight pasta with a silky tomato cream sauce.
RECIPES.instructions: Cook the pasta. Sauté garlic, add passata and cream, then toss with pasta and Parmesan.

RECIPES.name: Avocado Toast
RECIPES.description: Crispy toast topped with bright, creamy avocado and a poached egg.
RECIPES.instructions: Toast the bread and mash avocado with lemon and salt. Top with a poached egg and chili flakes.

RECIPES.name: Honey Garlic Chicken
RECIPES.description: Golden chicken thighs glazed with a sweet and savory garlic sauce.
RECIPES.instructions: Sear chicken until golden. Simmer with garlic, honey, and soy sauce until cooked through.

RECIPES.name: Rainbow Grain Bowl
RECIPES.description: A colorful, nourishing bowl with roasted vegetables and lemon tahini.
RECIPES.instructions: Arrange quinoa, vegetables, and chickpeas in a bowl. Drizzle with lemon tahini dressing.

RECIPES.name: Miso Ramen
RECIPES.description: A fast, warming ramen bowl packed with umami flavor.
RECIPES.instructions: Simmer broth with mushrooms and miso. Cook noodles separately, then combine and top with egg.

RECIPES.name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
RECIPES.description: A bright breakfast layered with creamy yogurt, fruit, and crunchy granola.
RECIPES.instructions: Layer yogurt, berries, and granola in a glass. Finish with honey and fresh mint.

RECIPES.name: Crispy Fish Tacos
RECIPES.description: Crunchy fish tacos finished with lime slaw and a cool crema.
RECIPES.instructions: Season and pan-fry the fish until crisp. Fill warm tortillas with fish, slaw, lime, and crema.

RECIPES.name: Mushroom Risotto
RECIPES.description: Creamy Arborio rice with earthy mushrooms and fresh herbs.
RECIPES.instructions: Sauté onion and rice, then add warm stock one ladle at a time. Fold in mushrooms, butter, and Parmesan.

RECIPES.name: Green Goddess Salad
RECIPES.description: A crisp chopped salad with herbs and a creamy green dressing.
RECIPES.instructions: Chop the vegetables and herbs. Toss with avocado and lemon yogurt dressing just before serving.

RECIPES.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
RECIPES.description: Soft-centered cookies with crisp edges and plenty of chocolate chips.
RECIPES.instructions: Cream butter and sugar, mix in egg and flour, then fold in chips. Bake scoops at 180°C for 10–12 minutes.
